page.notes: Line 10 (left of "Dans la vie de Charles VI."): the word after "Dans" is printed as "iene" with the first letter unclear; read as "Ie ne" with [?] marked. The English-style reading "ne trouue" is not certain and should be checked. The left edge of the scan shows book-edge marks and show-through, which were left out. Printing irregularities such as "Bellefores" and "Harseley" are kept as printed.
